item.title: SMALL ISLAND, BIG VOICE: REZ’91 STORYTELLER CONCERT
item.description: by Zeeb Amy King MUSKRATmagazine.com In our culture storytelling is a way to preserve our history as Anishnaabe people. Wasauksing First Nation is a small island with a big voice. The fourth annual Storyteller Concert was held at Wasauksing’s community arena in August 2014. The Anishnaabe have a rich history of storytelling which this concert […]

item.title: REZ 91 NOW OFFERING LIVE STREAMING
item.description: Rez 91 is really excited to now offer live streaming! Tune into our online radio stream and keep in touch with The Voice of the Anishinabek Nation, all the way from Parry Sound, Ontario direct to your home.
